partners.mechanism_chain: CFP (HGNC:1813) —DISRUPTS→ Alternative complement pathway activation (GO:0009101); Alternative complement pathway activation (GO:0009101) —LEADS_TO→ Increased susceptibility to Neisseria infections (HP:0002722); C3 (HGNC:255) —DISRUPTS→ Complement cascade activation (GO:0006955); Complement cascade activation (GO:0006955) —LEADS_TO→ Immunodeficiency (HP:0002722); Alternative complement pathway activation (GO:0009101) —INCREASES→ Complement cascade activation (GO:0006955). Loss-of-function mutations in CFP disrupt the alternative complement pathway, leading to increased susceptibility to Neisseria infections. The alternative complement pathway is a component of the broader complement cascade. Loss-of-function mutations in C3 disrupt the central complement cascade, leading to general immunodeficiency. The disruption of the alternative pathway by CFP deficiency contributes to the overall dysfunction of the complement cascade, thus converging on a shared pathway. Both diseases ultimately lead to increased susceptibility to infections, a shared phenotypic outcome.
